safety.summary: Dilute strong acid. Mildly irritating to eyes and skin, so wear goggles. Rinse spills with plenty of water.
safety.storage: Closed, labelled container, away from bases and metals.
safety.source: General laboratory safety guidance written for this project; check the supplier's safety data sheet before real use.
